data.exact_reserve_text: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 3.3m (2016: GBP 1.5m favourable deviation) was experienced during the year.
data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 3002 recorded a favourable prior-accident-year run-off in 2017, releasing GBP 3.3m in respect of prior years (a release equal to approximately 18.8% of the opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 17.563m). The movement is reported as a favourable run-off (release) and is attributed to favourable claims development.
raw_causal_phrases: A favourable run off deviation (prior accident year release) of GBP 3.3m (2016: GBP 1.5m favourable deviation) was experienced during the year.
data.data_quality_notes: Opening reserves taken from the Statement of Financial Position (Long term business provision) 2016 comparative column. Prior year movement taken from Note titled 'Movement in prior year's provision for claims outstanding' which explicitly states a GBP 3.3m favourable run-off; the note does not explicitly label the figure as gross or net, but it is presented as the movement in prior years' provision. A gross claims development triangle is present in the report (page 32) but parsing of the triangle rows/columns from the supplied text was ambiguous due to an 'X and prior' aggregate column and formatting; therefore the triangle was not used to recalculate the PYD. LOB mapping (Accident & Health) is an inferred mapping for long-term/term-life business; confidence for the LOB-specific allocation is lower than for the headline figures.
